lines.beaver_en: For next week's test, what should we study first?
lines.learner: 암기 과목부터 하자. 외울 게 많아.
lines.en: Let's start with the memorization subjects. There's a lot to memorize.
lines.roman: amgi gwamokbuteo haja. oeul ge mana.

lines.learner: 작문은 암기 끝나고 해. 감상문도 써야 돼.
lines.en: Let's do composition after memorizing. We also have to write a book report.
lines.roman: jangmuneun amgi kkeunnago hae. gamsangmundo sseoya dwae.

lines.beaver_en: Oh right, when was the book report due?
lines.learner: 금요일이야. 쓰기 전에 책을 다시 읽자.
lines.en: It's Friday. Let's reread the book before we write.
lines.roman: geumyoiriya. sseugi jeone chaegeul dasi ikja.

lines.beaver: 수학은 어떻게 해? 난 아직 초보야.
lines.beaver_en: What about math? I'm still a beginner.
lines.beaver_roman: suhageun eotteoke hae? nan ajik choboya.
lines.learner: 나도 잘 못해. 시험 전에 보충 수업 듣자.
lines.en: I'm not good at it either. Let's take a supplementary class before the test.
lines.roman: nado jal motae. siheom jeone bochung sueop deutja.

lines.beaver_en: Do you get private tutoring too?
lines.learner: 응, 주말에 과외 받아. 거기서 필기한 거 줄게.
lines.en: Yes, I get tutoring on weekends. I'll give you my notes from it.
lines.roman: eung, jumare gwaoe bada. geogiseo pilgihan geo julge.

lines.beaver: 고마워! 막상 시작하니까 할 게 많네.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks! Now that we've started, there's a lot to do.
lines.beaver_roman: gomawo! maksang sijakanikka hal ge manne.
lines.learner: 그러니까. 지난 성적표 보니까 영어가 약해.
lines.en: I know. Looking at my last report card, my English is weak.
lines.roman: geureonikka. jinan seongjeokpyo bonikka yeongeoga yakae.

lines.beaver_en: Let's do a little English every day.
lines.learner: 좋아. 자기 전에 단어 스무 개씩 외우자.
lines.en: Good. Let's memorize twenty words each before bed.
lines.roman: joa. jagi jeone daneo seumu gaessik oeuja.

lines.beaver_en: Do you think we can get full marks this time?
lines.learner: 응, 해 보자. 입시 전에 좋은 연습이 될 거야.
lines.en: Yeah, let's try. It'll be good practice before the entrance exam.
lines.roman: eung, hae boja. ipsi jeone joeun yeonseubi doel geoya.

lines.beaver: 맞아. 난 재수는 정말 하기 싫어.
lines.beaver_en: Right. I really don't want to retake the entrance exam.
lines.beaver_roman: maja. nan jaesuneun jeongmal hagi sireo.
lines.learner: 나도 재수는 싫어. 의지만 있으면 할 수 있어.
lines.en: I don't want to retake it either. We can do it if we have the will.
lines.roman: nado jaesuneun sireo. uijiman isseumyeon hal su isseo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 순서 정리 끝! 내일 도서관에서 볼까?
lines.beaver_en: Then our plan is done! Shall we meet at the library tomorrow?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom sunseo jeongni kkeut! naeil doseogwaneseo bolkka?
lines.learner: 응, 내일 아침 아홉 시에 만나. 화이팅!
lines.en: Yes, see you at nine tomorrow morning. Let's go!
lines.roman: eung, naeil achim ahop sie manna. hwaiting!
